decisions.statement: A file named in place and as a flag is refused.
A share URL and a bare id name the same file.
The name a fetched file lands under is the name Drive holds for that file.
A call naming no folder writes into the folder the call came from.
A folder that is not there is made before the file is written.
A write that throws after the folder was made names that folder in its refusal.
A folder that was already there is named nowhere, because nothing made it.
A refusal naming the folder it made keeps the kind of thing that went wrong.
A file in a native Google format is refused as the caller's mistake.
A file this consent cannot reach is answered as the data rather than as a fault.
Drive turning the consent away is answered as operational.
A Drive name that cannot be written to disk is answered as operational.

definition: the command writing one file out of Alan's Google Drive to disk under its Drive name
